Title: Public Preview: Azure Functions Support for Python 3.12

Body.Content:
You can now develop functions using Python 3.12 locally and deploy them to all Azure Functions plans.

Python 3.12 builds on the performance enhancements that were first released with Python 3.11 and adds a number of performance and language readability features in the interpreter.
Learn more.
